featured_reviews.name: Utkarsha Mhadeshwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity Kurla and it turned out to be a fantastic movie experience. It is definitely one of the best places in Mumbai to enjoy a film with friends or family.
The first thing that stands out is the excellent sound quality and screen clarity. The audio system is powerful and immersive, making every scene feel more engaging, especially during action or emotional moments. The picture quality is also very sharp and vibrant, which enhances the overall viewing experience. The theatre is well-maintained, and the seating is comfortable, allowing you to enjoy long movies without any discomfort.
The ambience of the cinema is also very impressive. From the moment you enter, the place feels premium and lively. It is located inside Phoenix Marketcity, so you also get a great mall environment with shopping and entertainment options before or after your movie.
Another major highlight is the variety of food and snacks available. You can choose from popcorn, nachos, burgers, beverages, and more. However, like most multiplexes, the food prices are on the higher side. While the quality is good, you should be prepared to spend a bit extra if you plan to eat there.
In terms of accessibility, the location is very convenient. You can easily reach the cinema by taking an auto rickshaw from Kurla or Vidyavihar railway station, making it a hassle-free destination for moviegoers.
Overall, PVR Cinemas at Phoenix Marketcity Kurla offers a premium and enjoyable movie experience with great sound, visuals, ambience, and accessibility—just keep in mind the slightly expensive food.

featured_reviews.name: Explorer
featured_reviews.review_text: Watched a movie at PVR Cinemas Phoenix Marketcity and had a great experience. The screens are large with excellent picture and sound quality, making the movie very immersive. Seating is comfortable and well-maintained, providing a good viewing experience. The theater is clean and staff are helpful. Located inside the mall, it’s convenient with plenty of food and shopping options nearby. Ticket prices are slightly on the higher side, but overall it’s a great place to enjoy movies in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Krittika Khandare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

featured_reviews.name: Irfan Hawaldar
featured_reviews.review_text: My recent visit to Maison IMAX for the Dhurandhar movie was an exceptionally luxurious experience. INOX Maison is clearly designed to provide a premium multiplex experience. The IMAX presentation was thoroughly enjoyable, with brilliant projector resolution and an outstanding sound system that delivered an immersive experience. featured_reviews.name: Joseph Lalrinhlua
featured_reviews.review_text: This theater has in my opinion, the best IMAX screen in Mumbai. It may not be the biggest, but it’s the newest and most premium. It can be a little pricey compared to other IMAX theaters but it’s all worth it. The place also has other smaller screens which are again pricey but if you like to watch movie in peace and tranquility, this is the best place to do it.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Jio PVR recently for an evening weekday show. The theatre itself was extremely clean, the seats were very comfortable, and the cooling was VERY strong — honestly, carry a jacket if you’re planning to watch a movie there because it gets quite cold inside. The overall ambience and maintenance were excellent.

Ticket pricing between ₹250–₹500 feels reasonable considering the cleanliness and comfort, especially if booked smartly on weekdays.

But as usual with PVR, the food pricing is absurd. Ordered a ₹350 Schezwan Paneer Wrap and it was a complete waste of money. The taste was terrible and definitely not worth the price. They serve it properly with a tray, plate, and cutlery, but realistically, how convenient is that setup inside a movie theatre while watching a film in the dark?

Popcorn and drinks are also heavily overpriced, and the quantity doesn’t justify the cost either.

Overall: great theatre experience for seating, cleanliness, and ambience — but avoid spending too much on the food unless you’re okay paying premium prices for average quality.

The sound though is 5 channel, sounds amazing. The prices are not hight too. The best seats are the middle seats in the 4th row from down, if you like the screen in front of your face. Its a great experience from that seat. Or if you like to see it from behind, go for rows after the extra legroom row. Avoid the extra legroom row. It's unnecessary, expensive, and the front seat block the view. Equivalent to this is the lower parel imax. Both of these are exceptional imax theatres. You can go to any one.

featured_reviews.name: prasad sikandar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Natraj Cinema, a name synonymous with cinematic entertainment, has been a cultural cornerstone in the heart of the city for decades. Located in the bustling center of town, Natraj Cinema has earned a reputation as a beloved destination for movie enthusiasts and families seeking a dose of entertainment and relaxation.

The cinema's rich history traces back to an era when movie theaters were more than just places to watch films; they were community hubs, where neighbors gathered to share laughter, thrills, and sometimes tears. Natraj Cinema has upheld this tradition, offering not just movies but an experience that transcends the silver screen.

Natraj Cinema boasts state-of-the-art facilities, including cutting-edge sound systems and high-definition screens, ensuring a top-notch audio-visual experience for its patrons. The cinema's comfortable seating and inviting ambiance create a welcoming atmosphere, making every visit a memorable one.

What sets Natraj Cinema apart is its diverse selection of films. From the latest blockbusters to critically acclaimed independent movies and regional gems, the cinema caters to a wide audience, embracing varied tastes and preferences. Families flock to Natraj Cinema for its family-friendly screenings, creating cherished memories together.

Moreover, Natraj Cinema stands as a cultural beacon, hosting film festivals, premieres, and special events that celebrate the art of cinema. It serves as a platform for budding filmmakers, providing a space where creativity and innovation are nurtured and appreciated.

Beyond its cinematic offerings, Natraj Cinema engages with the community, organizing charity events, fundraisers, and awareness campaigns. The cinema believes in giving back to the society it serves, making a positive impact beyond the realm of entertainment.

In essence, Natraj Cinema is not merely a movie theater; it is a cherished institution that weaves stories, emotions, and togetherness into the fabric of the community. It continues to illuminate the silver screen, bringing joy and entertainment to generations, ensuring that the magic of cinema lives on, one screening at a time.

featured_reviews.name: Venkat Krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text: I saw it from outside and came to know what would be inside. I was a resident of Chembur from 1960 to 1991. I still remember, during the 60s, it was pride of Chembur as it was the only air conditioned  theatre in the area and going there to watch any movie with family and friends was a great pleasure for all. AC was very powerful, seats very comfortable, picture and sound quality excellent, canteen used to serve tasty samosas, snacks and beverages at reasonable prices. Management was talking pains to maintain the ambience and decor. But over the period, due to poor management, improper maintenance, the quality deteriorated gradually and it has come to the present stage. Added to all these, competition from multiplexes has caused further damage. Most surprising is still it continues to run against all odds is something great. I doubt will there be any scope for improvement. The best option will be to sell the land to some potential builder who can build Shopping mall or residential tower, as the place is strategically located (very close to railway station and bus stop ). Rest is left to God.

This is not just a review—this is a formal complaint regarding the extremely poor conditions inside the theatre.

I am currently inside the auditorium, and the air conditioning and ventilation systems appear to be completely non-functional. The environment is unacceptably hot and suffocating, making it impossible to sit comfortably, let alone enjoy the movie. Customers are paying premium prices with the expectation of a comfortable and well-maintained environment. What is being delivered here is far below acceptable standards and reflects a complete disregard for customer well-being.

featured_reviews.name: Namdev Gawade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited PVR Ghatkopar East to watch the movie Raje Shivaji. During the movie, the screen suddenly went off in the middle of the show. Unfortunately, no staff member took the initiative to inform or assist the audience regarding the issue.
After informing the Duty Manager, Mr. Suryavanshi, he stated that there was a technical issue in the backend due to which the movie got stuck. However, instead of apologizing for the inconvenience caused, his behavior was rude and unprofessional. He simply mentioned that the movie would restart in the next 15 minutes.
When we expressed our disappointment and asked why the movie experience was being disturbed, he responded by saying that it was a technical issue and that he could not do anything about it.
As customers, we expect at least basic courtesy, proper communication, and respectful behavior during such situations. Overall, we felt that there was no concern shown towards customers’ time, money, or emotions.
I kindly request you to look into this matter seriously and ensure that polite, responsible, and customer-friendly managers are assigned to handle such situations in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Sai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fun Cinemas, located on the 4th floor of K Star Mall in Chembur, offers a standard movie-going experience with some notable positives and areas that could use improvement. One of the standout aspects of this theatre is its diverse language screenings, including Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, and English. This makes it a great option for regional movie lovers in Mumbai who want to catch films in their native language.

The sound and visual quality are commendable, with Dolby Atmos enhancing the audio experience and the screen clarity being satisfactory. These technical aspects ensure that the core movie-watching experience is enjoyable. The theatre is also conveniently located near Diamond Garden and is close to Ghatala railway station, making it easily accessible for locals and commuters.

However, the theatre's location in an old and mostly abandoned mall detracts significantly from the overall experience. The mall feels deserted, especially at night, which creates an eerie and isolated atmosphere. Inside, the seating, although slightly repaired and improved, is still average, with some chairs showing signs of wear and tear. The maintenance of the premises is also below par, with cleanliness in common areas needing much more attention.

The food and beverage options are decent, with the nachos and cool drinks standing out as personal favorites. However, like most multiplexes in Mumbai, the prices are high, which doesn’t always align with the quality or portion sizes. There have also been occasional complaints about stale food, which is disappointing.

In conclusion, Fun Cinemas in K Star Mall is a decent choice if you’re looking to watch movies in regional languages or live nearby. However, the outdated ambiance, maintenance issues, and high prices make it a less appealing option compared to other multiplexes in the city.

featured_reviews.name: Dev Sai
featured_reviews.review_text:
My visit to INOX Neelyog in Ghatkopar East was a bit of a mixed experience. While the theatre itself is okay, it feels like a bit of a deserted venue. The mall it’s located in is quite old, and despite being owned by PVR-INOX, the place feels stuck in time, lacking the modern amenities you’d expect from their brand. It doesn’t have the same fresh, updated atmosphere as other PVR-INOX theatres.

Its proximity to the Ghatkopar Railway Station makes it a convenient choice for moviegoers relying on public transport.

The seating was decent, but there was nothing exceptional about it. The overall maintenance seemed lacking, and the place just felt a bit neglected. The staff were polite, but the overall service felt a bit lackluster, especially when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres. The staff seemed understaffed, and there were minor delays in service, particularly at the concession stand. As for maintenance, it was evident that the theatre could use some attention. The cleanliness in the common areas and washrooms was below par, and the seats, though functional, showed signs of wear and tear.

The ticket prices were reasonable, but when compared to other PVR-INOX theatres, this one doesn’t justify the price for the experience it offers. Snacks were also the standard fare, but the portions were smaller, and they didn’t feel as fresh.

In summary, while it wasn’t a terrible experience, it felt more like a theatre stuck in the past, lacking the vibrant and well-maintained vibe you’d expect from a PVR-INOX property. It’s good if you're in the area, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.

featured_reviews.name: Faizal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Movie theatre near Ghatkopar railway station and have some mixed feelings about my experience. The screen size and quality were average, which was a bit disappointing. However, the sound quality was good, which enhanced the overall movie-watching experience.

The biggest issue I faced was the crowd at the lift due to the mandatory security check. It took a long time to get through the line, and it was quite frustrating. I would recommend taking the stairs if your screen is located on a lower level to avoid the crowd and save time.

The chairs were also of average quality, not too comfortable, but not uncomfortable either. However, the air conditioning was good, which made the experience more enjoyable.

Overall, I would say that this movie theatre is a decent option for watching movies, especially if you're in the area. However, it has its drawbacks, such as the average screen size and quality and the crowd at the lift during security check. If you can manage to take the stairs and don't mind the average chair quality, it could be a good option for you.

featured_reviews.name: Charlie Dha Champion
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I recently visited this theater expecting a decent movie-watching experience, but it turned out to be an absolute disaster.
To put it simply, everything about this place is below average, and it is easily one of the worst theaters I have ever been to.
​The biggest letdown was the audio quality. In this era of advanced surround sound and Dolby systems, this theater feels like it is stuck in the past. The sound was flat, muffled, and lacked any depth. Honestly, it felt like listening to a movie on a cheap Bluetooth speaker rather than a professional cinema hall system. The bass was nonexistent, and the dialogue was barely clear.the screen quality was poor. A theater is supposed to provide an immersive experience, but this place failed on every front. I highly recommend avoiding this theater until they completely upgrade their sound system and facilities. It is a total waste of time and money.

I recently visited Rajhansh Cinema in Ghatkopar. The movie ticket was ₹300, which is fine, but the theatre quality honestly didn’t match the price. The projector seemed dull and outdated, which really affects the viewing experience.
I also bought food from the counter — ₹200 for fries that were even smaller than a McDonald's small fries, and a pizza for ₹250 that was quite small and average in taste. Overall, the food felt overpriced for the quantity and quality provided.
I hope they improve the theatre experience and food value, especially considering the prices they charge.
